item.title: 🔵 Malicious npm packages abuse dependency confusion to profile developer environments
item.description:
Why this matters: Hospitality system impact — check guest-facing services and PMS/POS status.

A dependency confusion campaign leveraged 33 malicious npm packages to collect reconnaissance data from developer and build environments. This report details the attack chain, observed tradecraft, and detection opportunities to help organizations identify and disrupt related activity.

The post Malicious npm packages abuse dependency confusion to profile developer environments appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog.

item.title: 🟠 Typosquatted npm packages used to steal cloud and CI/CD secrets
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and user awareness training.

The Mini Shai-Hulud campaign used malicious npm packages to target cloud and CI/CD credentials across developer environments. This report details the attack chain, detection opportunities, and mitigation guidance to help organizations identify and disrupt related activity.

The post Typosquatted npm packages used to steal cloud and CI/CD secrets appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog.
